ESTABLISHED_PROPOSITIONS.proposition: Issued final_permit cover pages authorize discharge only under named Parts 'hereof' (Parts I–III, or I–IV for Farmington).
Part II appendices are incorporated into the issued permit by internal cross-reference to 'Appendix A of Part II of this permit.'
Farmington Part IV is part of the governing corpus via cover-page reference to 'Part IV hereof.'
Fact sheets and statements of basis frame content as draft/proposed rationale and administrative record, not standalone authorization.
Reasonable-potential files are calculation appendices to fact sheets, not independent authorization documents.
Inventory document_kind can mismatch document header text (Farmington statement_of_basis labeled FACT SHEET).
